preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(c in s for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: All characters in the output must be present in the input string.
The output must contain unique characters.
Each character in the output must appear more than once in the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(s.index(c) < s.rindex(c) for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output must have a first and last occurrence in the input string.
